import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from research.post_v5.development import load_development,BOUNDARY
from research.post_v5.experiments import reference_close
from scripts.post_v5_research import clean
root=Path.cwd();directory=root/'reports/post_v5/development-20261009T083921-00e775cf'
frames,refs,settings,universe,protocol=load_development('f0805fb58dbd033fc42f7f3dafdf1c1315a69c0e039d3e1ae63ace8abe865672')
market_calendar=reference_close(refs['market_india']).index
rows=[];hashes={};bad_counts=[]
for ticker,raw in frames.items():
    calendar=market_calendar[(market_calendar>=raw.index.min())&(market_calendar<=raw.index.max())]
    aligned=raw.reindex(calendar)
    bad=(aligned.Volume.to_numpy()<=0)|~np.isfinite(aligned[['Open','High','Low','Close','Volume']].to_numpy()).all(axis=1)
    bad_counts.append({'ticker':ticker,'aligned_sessions':len(aligned),'invalid_observed_or_missing_sessions':int(bad.sum()),'zero_or_negative_volume_sessions':int((aligned.Volume<=0).sum()),'missing_or_nonfinite_sessions':int((~np.isfinite(aligned[['Open','High','Low','Close','Volume']].to_numpy()).all(axis=1)).sum()),'invalid_session_dates':[str(d.date()) for d in calendar[bad]]})
for horizon in protocol['horizons']:
    path=directory/('PREDICTIONS_H'+str(horizon)+'.csv.gz')
    hashes[path.name]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    p=pd.read_csv(path,float_precision='round_trip');p=p.loc[p.model=='ridge']
    checked=0
    for ticker,g in p.groupby('ticker'):
        raw=frames[ticker]
        calendar=market_calendar[(market_calendar>=raw.index.min())&(market_calendar<=raw.index.max())]
        aligned=raw.reindex(calendar)
        bad=(aligned.Volume.to_numpy()<=0)|~np.isfinite(aligned[['Open','High','Low','Close','Volume']].to_numpy()).all(axis=1)
        for row in g.itertuples(index=False):
            origin=pd.Timestamp(row.origin_session);position=calendar.get_loc(origin)
            assert not bad[max(0,position-199):position+1].any(),(ticker,horizon,origin,'invalid200-session-feature-history')
            assert not bad[position:position+horizon+1].any(),(ticker,horizon,origin,'invalid-intervening-label-session')
            expected=calendar[position+horizon]
            label=pd.Timestamp(row.label_end)
            expected_information_time=pd.Timestamp(str(expected.date()),tz='UTC')+(pd.Timedelta('1D20min') if expected.dayofweek>=5 else pd.Timedelta('10h20min'))
            assert label==expected_information_time,(ticker,horizon,origin,'wrong-maturity-information-time')
            actual=np.log(aligned.Close.iloc[position+horizon]/aligned.Close.iloc[position])
            assert np.isclose(row.actual,actual,atol=1e-14,rtol=1e-12),(ticker,horizon,origin,'wrong-return-label')
            assert pd.Timestamp(row.feature_time)<BOUNDARY and pd.Timestamp(row.label_end)<BOUNDARY
            checked+=1
    rows.append({'horizon':horizon,'unique_scored_origin_stock_rows_verified':checked,'stocks':int(p.ticker.nunique()),'dates':int(p.origin_session.nunique()),'max_feature_time':str(pd.to_datetime(p.feature_time,utc=True).max()),'max_label_end':str(pd.to_datetime(p.label_end,utc=True).max()),'zero_bad_history_or_forward_violations':True,'exact_calendar_maturities':True})
    del p
payload={'audit_id':'corrected-source-mask-audit-v2','experiment_id':directory.name,'source_guard':'independent NumPy positional slices:200-session past and horizon+1 forward; no Series reindex alignment','no_model_refits':True,'final_data_used':False,'input_sha256':hashes,'rows':rows,'source_quality':bad_counts}
with (directory/'SOURCE_MASK_AUDIT.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(clean(payload),f,allow_nan=False)
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','rows':rows,'no_refits':True,'source_mask_enforced':True}))
